args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (deployed to all production regions) began failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback completed successfully; monitoring for recovery.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the failure and the rollback action.

4. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback status shows v2.3.0 healthy in all regions with error rate back down to 0.2%.

Note: v2.3.1 remains the known-bad release — the on-call engineer should investigate the root cause before any re-deploy attempt.
